svg.aria-label: Architecture of the guideline formalization system, minimal view. Four stages run left to right: extract, ground, formalize, and check. Exactly four components -- shaded -- call a model, each with an output space too small to contain a hallucination: a verbatim quote, an exact substring, a position in a candidate list, or a name enumerated from a closed registry. Every other component is deterministic. Each stage produces an explicit artifact, shown as a chip at the foot of its column, that confines what the next stage may say. The artifact is also named on the connecting arrow itself, and a legend below the residue channel explains every box and line style. A residue channel runs beneath all four stages, carrying six refusal reasons: one set deterministically by the binder, one by the validator, a third mixed, and the remaining three requiring the model.

text.tspan: Parses JATS, HTML or PDF into one Block type;
every offset maps back to the raw text. A cheap
regex prefilter keeps a 600-candidate document
affordable before any model is ever called.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: Decides if this is direct clinical action about
a patient. Must return a verbatim quote from the
source — a paraphrase is rejected and a
deterministic heuristic runs instead.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:11px; fill:#0B5F55; letter-spacing:.03em
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9px; fill:#4A5450

svg.text: verbatim, with a locator and character offsets

text.style: font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; fill:#0B5F55
font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#7C8783
font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: Pulls clinical phrases out of a sentence as exact
substrings, tagged lab, condition, drug, drug
class or procedure — the tag decides which
terminologies are even searched.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: Ranked by word overlap over SNOMED, LOINC,
RxNorm, ATC and VSAC. A semantic fallback finds
candidates by MEANING — only when no exact term
matches, and never outranking one that does.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: Returns a POSITION in the candidate list, or −1
— a hallucinated code is not a thing it can say.
Re-verified afterward with no model involved.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:11px; fill:#0B5F55; letter-spacing:.03em
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9px; fill:#4A5450

svg.text: the closed vocabulary the decoder is confined to

text.style: font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; fill:#0B5F55
font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#7C8783
font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: Writes the rule, or declines to — the schema
admits exactly one of the two. Variable and event
names are enumerated from the registry, so an
unknown name cannot appear.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: Types, units, an action a plan can change — then
asks Z3 whether the rule can ever apply, comply,
or be violated. A rule no patient can fail
certifies nothing, and compiles perfectly.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: Bound vocabulary first. Any binder failure forces
a retry with the undefined predicate declared as
a free variable, quoted from the statement —
never trusted as encoded just because it typechecks.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:11px; fill:#0B5F55; letter-spacing:.03em
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9px; fill:#4A5450

svg.text: φ = when → then, an operator, and any named holes

text.style: font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; fill:#0B5F55
font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:15px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#7C8783
font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: UNSAT(D∧P∧φ) → MUST-violate. UNSAT(D∧P∧¬φ) →
CERTIFIED-compliant. Neither → MAY-violate. A
permission has no violating patient, by
construction — not a guard on a verdict string.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: A standalone FHIR library. Value sets carry
their version, thresholds keep their units, and
a hole is left null rather than assumed false.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:12px; fill:#111614
font-family:JetBrains Mono, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace; font-size:9.5px; fill:#4A5450
text.tspan: The machine artifact and a page for a person:
each source sentence beside the rule it became,
with the refusals listed alongside it.

svg.text: ONE of the six is deterministic evidence from the binder, and one more from this stage's validator; a third is mixed. The other three need the model — to decline, or, for not_patient_level, to have classified the statement upstream.

text.style: font-family:Archivo, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-style:italic; fill:#4A5450

svg.text: So the deterministic machinery is a GATE ON the model's answer, not a replacement for it. Attribution is reported separately again: an index gap or a transport failure is our bug, not the guideline's residue.
